tldr: Mars in Libra: action is relational, strategic, and shaped by fairness.
body: With Mars in Libra, drive moves through negotiation, partnership, and social awareness. Mars is in detriment here, so direct action may get delayed by the need to keep balance.
gift: Diplomatic courage, tactical charm, and the ability to fight for fairness.
challenge: Indecision, approval-seeking, and conflict avoidance that becomes resentment.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
